profile.summary: The Peria Karamalai Tea and Produce Company Limited produces and distributes tea in India. The company operates tea gardens located in Valparai that produces green tea, and orthodox and ctc black tea. It also offers coffee, black pepper, and spices, as well as fruits, such as avocados.
